answer_1.quote: We use math-lm-eval ... to evaluate the accuracy on GSM8K, MATH, Minerva, MMLU-STEM, SVAMP, and MathQA. For coding ability, we use the evaluation kit from DeepSeek-Coder to assess the pass@1 accuracy on HumanEval and MBPP. For evaluating command generation ability, we use two benchmarks CMDGen-NVIDIA and CMDGen-AMD ...
answer_1.outputs: textual answers to math problems, generated code snippets, and generated system commands

answer_2.quote: We evaluate math reasoning ability using accuracy on benchmarks ... For coding ability, we assess pass@1 accuracy ... For command generation, we evaluate using CMD Sim, Output Sim, Approx Acc, Exact Match, Success Ratio, and Accuracy.
